description: DataFactZ Canvas Table Visual is a high-performance, enterprise-grade data grid for Power BI that brings spreadsheet-like interactivity and advanced data exploration directly into your reports. Designed for analysts and business users who have outgrown the default table and matrix visuals, Canvas Table delivers fast rendering on large datasets, deep formatting control, and Excel-familiar interactions — all within a single, fully customizable visual. Key features: - Multi-column sorting and advanced column-level filtering - Row grouping, aggregation, and expandable hierarchies - Pivoting with dynamic row and column dimensions - Inline sparklines for trend visualization within rows - Pinned (frozen) columns and resizable, reorderable headers - Conditional formatting: color scales, data bars, icons, and rules - Custom cell formatting, fonts, alignment, and number formats - Smooth scrolling and virtualization for large data volumes - Header styling, banded rows, and theme-aware color schemes - Totals, subtotals, and footer aggregations - Configurable column visibility and persistent layouts True self-service analytics — without leaving Power BI: Canvas Table eliminates the constant "export to Excel" workflow that breaks governance, fragments data across mailboxes, and slows down decision-making. Business users get the spreadsheet-like power they expect — sort, filter, pivot,…
